Texto temático con vocabulario de N1: ne: Themed text with N1 vocabulary: business, figures and decisions.

Texto temático con vocabulario de N1: ci: Themed text with N1 vocabulary: the city, walks and moods.

Texto temático con vocabulario de N1: tr: Themed text with N1 vocabulary: transport, mishaps and paperwork.

Texto temático con vocabulario de N1: sa: Themed text with N1 vocabulary: tailoring, materials and taste.

Texto temático con vocabulario de N1: me: Themed text with N1 vocabulary: media, opinion and society.

Texto temático con vocabulario de N1: tr: Themed text with N1 vocabulary: office work, courtesy and relationships.
